title: 调用第三方GPT-5时失败
body:
### 📦 部署环境

Vercel

### 📦 部署模式

服务端模式(lobe-chat-database 镜像)

### 📌 软件版本

v1.111.11

### 💻 系统环境

iOS

### 🌐 浏览器

Chrome

### 🐛 问题描述

错误提示如下：
{
  "code": "invalid_text_request",
  "type": "openai_error",
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_text_request",
    "type": "openai_error",
    "param": "",
    "message": "json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field url of type bool  (request id: 20250813201339277006589EtSGahGi)"
  },
  "param": "",
  "status": 400,
  "headers": {
    "date": "Wed, 13 Aug 2025 12:13:40 GMT",
    "connection": "keep-alive",
    "content-type": "text/event-stream",
    "cache-control": "no-cache",
    "transfer-encoding": "chunked",
    "x-rixapi-request-id": "20250813201339277006589EtSGahGi"
  },
  "provider": "openai"
}

### 📷 复现步骤

_No response_

### 🚦 期望结果

_No response_

### 📝 补充信息

该供应商的其他模型均可正常响应，但此特定模型出现异常。经与供应商沟通确认，对方分析认为：该模型使用的是逆向的chat接口，而 LobeHub 统一调用官方最新的 response 接口，两者接口规范不兼容，导致请求失败

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

支持设置 `OPENAI_SERVICE_TIER_FLEX=1` 启用 Flex 优惠模式。

https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/flex-processing

- fix #6735

----

另 GPT-5 不再强制使用 responses api模式。

- fix #8786

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

<!-- Add any other context about the Pull Request here. -->

## Summary by Sourcery

Support the Flex service tier for eligible OpenAI models when toggled via env var and ensure stream_options are only sent when stream is enabled

New Features:
- Enable optional Flex service tier via OPENAI_SERVICE_TIER_FLEX environment variable
- Automatically attach service_tier:'flex' to OpenAI requests for supported models

Bug Fixes:
- Include stream_options in API payload only when streaming is enabled

Enhancements:
- Add supportsFlexTier helper function and flexSupportedModels list to manage Flex eligibility

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves incompatibility with an LLM provider (OpenAI) due to mismatched API usage for the GPT-5 model, which aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category.
